title: Launch synchronization plan: windows, cutover rules, and release notes coordination for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Aisha Menon
description: Purpose: Create a single-source launch synchronization plan that defines release windows, scope lock rules, cut criteria, and the release-notes coordination process for the combined API, Console, and Runtime release. Scope: covers milestones from scope lock through post-launch monitoring and rollback windows. Out of scope: long-term roadmap items, feature prioritization outside the release window. Goals: 1) avoid cross-team last-minute scope creep; 2) produce timely, localized release notes and PR communications; 3) coordinate go-to-market tasks (blog, release emails, partner notifications) with clear owners and deadlines; 4) ensure safe rollouts with defined rollback criteria and SLO checks.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone calendar published with owners and public release window
Cut criteria checklist agreed by Eng/Design/Security/Docs and referenced in PR template
Release notes template finalized and localized assets pipeline created
Cross-team GTM task list with owners and due dates visible in shared sheet
Rollback and post-launch monitoring playbook accepted by SRE and Support
steps: Draft milestone timeline (scope lock, code freeze, validation, release, rollback window) - PM lead
Run a cross-functional review session to finalize cut criteria and exceptions - invite ENG, DES, SRE, Legal, Docs, Sales Ops
Bake cut criteria into PR checklist and CI gates; attach tickets to release train
Finalize release notes template and translation owners; set localization deadlines
Publish GTM checklist and assign owners for blog, changelog, support scripts, and partner comms
Schedule dry-run of release notes publication and post-launch dashboard verification
Lock roadmap changes 72 hours before code freeze unless exception approved by PM/ENG leads
cut_criteria: All critical and high severity regressions fixed in release branch
e2e smoke tests pass against runtime-prod-like infra within validation window
No open SECURITY or COMPLIANCE blocking issues
Performance SLOs for median latency and error rate met in pre-release soak
Documentation and release notes draft complete and owner-assigned
DB/config migrations have rollback plan and tested migration job
release_notes_process: Owner: Docs team (Samira Ortiz) to maintain canonical changelog
Template fields: summary, impacted APIs, behavioral changes, migration steps, risk level, rollback instructions, example snippets
Localization: +3 business days for translated copy; languages: EN, FR, DE, JP
Legal review: required for anything affecting data residency or terms; SLA-affecting items flagged
Approval flow: Draft -> PM review -> ENG technical check -> Legal sign-off -> Publish
Publish channels: release notes site, developer newsletter, in-console banner for major incompatibilities
gtm_tasks: Blog post draft with SPOC and technical author assigned
Support playbook and troubleshooting runbook created
Pricing or plan changes communicated to Revenue team if applicable
Partner notification templates prepared and scheduled
SDK/CLI release coordination with SDK owners
Demo environment updated and smoke-checked for marketing demos
rollback_and_monitoring: Rollback criteria: repeatable regression causing >1% error rate or SLA breach for >15m
Immediate action owner: SRE on-call; PM to coordinate customer comms
Post-launch monitoring: token-level latency, error rate, queue depth, memory spikes, KV cache hit-rate
Escalation path: Support -> SRE -> Eng Lead -> PM
Post-incident notes: timeline, root cause, remediation plan, customer outreach draft
risks: Localization delays causing late release-note publication
Undiscovered perf regressions at scale in runtime integration tests
Unaligned owner expectations leading to missed dry-run
Legal review window could delay publish if not flagged early
notes: Proposed scope-lock lead time: 7 days before code freeze for non-critical changes
Exceptions: security fixes may be backported with explicit approval from ENG lead and PM
Consider a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) for runtime changes with metrics checkpoint gates
We should add a brief in-console changelog widget for 48 hours post-launch linking to full release notes
